scripts.test: pnpm run test:social && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:backend && node --test Aplicativo/back/test/username-policy.test.mjs Aplicativo/back/test/relationship-view.test.mjs Aplicativo/back/test/auth-presentation-boundary.test.mjs Aplicativo/back/test/feed-layer-boundary.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx --test ../Aplicativo/back/test/profile-visibility.test.mjs ../Aplicativo/back/test/feed-visibility.test.mjs ../Aplicativo/back/test/health-readiness.test.mjs
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && PORT=${PORT:-5000} BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./Aplicativo/**" --filter "./shared/**" --filter "./infra/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run typecheck
